en.title: GTA 6 Album Tracklist Leaks: Justice, Travis Scott, and More Confirmed
en.summary: Just days before its highly anticipated launch, the full soundtrack for Grand Theft Auto VI has seemingly leaked online, offering fans a glimpse at the artists and songs featured. This leak comes after a series of earlier leaks that have plagued Rockstar Games.
en.body:
The digital streets of Vice City are already humming with new music, as the complete tracklist for **Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album** appears to have surfaced online just days before the game's November 19, 2026 release. This latest leak, which details a 34-track compilation, follows a tumultuous period of unprecedented leaks that have given fans an early, albeit unofficial, look at **Rockstar Games**' magnum opus. The soundtrack, expected to be available on CD and vinyl, features an eclectic mix of global talent, hinting at the vibrant sonic landscape players can expect.

While **Rockstar Games** has remained tight-lipped about many specific details, the leaked album cover and tracklist, reportedly confirmed by Rolling Stone sources, showcase a star-studded lineup. Headlining the album are significant contributions from electronic duo **Justice**, who are credited on multiple tracks including "Starting from Zero" and "Flower in a Hurricane," the latter featuring **Tame Impala**, **SZA**, and **King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard**. Hip-hop heavyweights such as **Travis Scott** with "Rhyno," **Playboi Carti** with "Ahh Yea," and **Future** and **Metro Boomin** on "That's It" are also prominently featured. The album also taps into the Latin music scene with artists like **Rauw Alejandro** and **Fuerza Regida**, alongside contemporary pop sensations like **Dua Lipa** and **PinkPantheress**. Notably, country star **Morgan Wallen** appears on "Last Thing You Need," marking a potentially broad appeal for the soundtrack.

## A Soundtrack for the Ages
The **GTA** franchise has always been synonymous with its meticulously crafted radio stations and iconic soundtracks, acting as a crucial element in immersing players in its distinct virtual worlds. From the classic rock anthems of **Vice City** to the diverse genres of **Grand Theft Auto V**, music has consistently been a character in itself. This latest leaked list suggests **Rockstar Games** is continuing this tradition with **GTA 6**, blending established global superstars with rising artists and even surprise genre crossovers. The inclusion of artists like **CA7RIEL**, **Paco Amoroso**, and **Étienne de Crécy** alongside **Fred Again..** hints at a soundtrack that aims to capture both mainstream appeal and niche electronic music sensibilities, promising a rich auditory experience that mirrors the game's expansive and diverse setting.

## Fan Reactions and What's Next
News of the soundtrack leak has sent ripples through the **GTA** community, with fans eagerly dissecting the tracklist and speculating on how these songs will integrate into the gameplay experience. While some are thrilled by the confirmed artists, others are debating the potential impact of certain inclusions. **Rockstar Games** has confirmed that an official extended look at **GTA 6** will still proceed as planned on August 27, where more details about the game, and potentially its music, will be revealed. Pre-orders for the game are set to open on June 25, 2026, with the game launching on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.

content_raw: The full track list for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album seems to have leaked online just days before GTA 6 's launch. Rockstar Games just can't catch a break. After weeks of unprecedented leaks were published online, even more information about GTA 6 has found its way onto the internet, this time revealing the entire list of every song and artist featured on the official soundtrack's album release. As 13 years turns into just a few days, more leaks felt inevitable. The latest breach arrived in the form of a video shared on social media from what appears to be a Barnes & Noble-like retailer. The main clip being passed around is still up hours later and shows the front, back, and spines of the Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album's double LP vinyl. As you might have guessed, the $50 soundtrack isn't planned to hit store shelves until November 19, 2026. An early glimpse at the GTA 6 soundtrack means we now know every song and artist featured on the album. Rolling Stone has confirmed the track list with its sources. We won't beat around the bush; you can see the full Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album track list below. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album Leaked Track List Side A Starting from Zero – Justice (feat. Michael McDonald) That's It – Yung Lean (feat. Future & Metro Boomin) Ahh Yea – Playboi Carti Rhyno – Travis Scott Sexy Magic – CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred Again.. & Étienne de Crécy Flower in a Hurricane – Justice (feat. Tame Impala, SZA & King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard) Go Easy – Dua Lipa Last Thing You Need – Morgan Wallen Side B X – Jhayco Suzuki – Fuerza Regida Macacoa 2000 – Rauw Alejandro Dance With Me – Boogie Wit Da Hoodie (feat. Elkan) Bigger – Burna Boy Count Up – Gunna Let's Rock – Kodak Black & Don Toliver Wakin Up Flex – Young Thug IKYFL – Tee Grizzly TF? – Don Toliver Side C Don't Chart – Cardi B GMA – JT Power Trip – Jennie Blood in Your Eyes – Tove Lo Fast Emotion – Zara Larsson Sweet Like Candy – Camila Cabello Only One – Fcukers Sanduneguea – Arca TRDWFE – Rina Sawayama Side D All Again – Rose Gray Crazy for You – Lana Del Rey Largate – Kali Uchis & Helado Negro No Me Busques – Omar Apollo Bright Lights, Big City – Keith Richards Stone Cold Krazy Luuv – Jesse Johnson & DāM-FunK Overtown Lights – Stanley Clarke, Yussef Dayes & Robert Glasper We've gotten tastes of the music Rockstar hand-selected to be featured through the years, with stars like Travis Scott, Future, and Morgan Wallen teasing their inclusion as recently as September . We also got to hear some of GTA 6's tunes with the premiere of the Extended Look back in August. As many guessed, the developers have given players a solid playlist of songs from a variety of genres to jam to as they speed through Vice City. Fans will note this is different from the Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score by Grammy Award-winning French electronic duo Justice. It's also set to get its own release for physical music collectors, with its release date set for December 11, 2026. GT
